name: App Icon: Duotone Crossed Blades Kamon
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Symmetrical Blade Kamon Emblem.
description: Two sleek crossed pure solid black katana swords forming a bold X crest inside a single solid flat bright red circular sun on pitch black canvas.
prompt: Masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector logo icon. Symmetrical crossed pure solid black Japanese samurai katana swords forming a bold X emblem with thin red blade highlights. (Centered inside a single solid flat bright red circular sun disc:1.4). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only (#FF2035). Flat 2D vector logo mark, razor-sharp clean geometric edges, no gradients, no 3D rendering, no textures, no text, no watermark.
